name: finance_sox_icfr
description: Finance SOX 404 Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) compliance lifecycle with PCAOB AS 2201 framework

verified_sources.source: PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 2201, Appendix A, Definition of Material Weakness
verified_sources.notes: No quantitative threshold; auditor judgment required. AS 2201 amendments effective December 15, 2026.

verified_sources.value: Important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance
verified_sources.source: PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 2201, Appendix A, Definition of Significant Deficiency
verified_sources.notes: Guidance framework; requires professional judgment and context

verified_sources.source: SEC Regulation S-X, Rule 1-02(w), Definition of Accelerated Filer
verified_sources.notes: Also requires $100M+ revenue. Determined as of June 30 of prior fiscal year.

verified_sources.metric: Large Accelerated Filer Threshold — Public Float
verified_sources.source: SEC Regulation S-X, Rule 1-02(x), Definition of Large Accelerated Filer
verified_sources.notes: Also requires $100M+ revenue. Stricter audit requirements than accelerated filers.

verified_sources.value: Exempt from auditor attestation on ICFR
verified_sources.source: SEC Regulation S-X, Rule 1-02(q), Definition of Non-Accelerated Filer; SOX 404(b) exemption
verified_sources.notes: Still required to do management's assessment under 404(a); auditor attestation (404(b)) waived

verified_sources.source: SEC Form 10-K Instructions, Item 1 (General), Filing Deadline
verified_sources.notes: Applies to accelerated and large accelerated filers only

verified_sources.source: SEC Form 10-K Instructions, Item 1 (General), Filing Deadline
verified_sources.notes: Extended deadline for non-accelerated and smaller reporting companies

verified_sources.value: Up to 10 years imprisonment and/or $1,000,000 fine
verified_sources.notes: Applies to CFO/CEO false certifications. Effective 2002; still current law 2025-2026.

verified_sources.value: Up to 20 years imprisonment and/or $5,000,000 fine
verified_sources.notes: Enhanced penalties for intentional false certifications. Effective 2002; still current 2025-2026.

verified_sources.source: PCAOB Release No. 2024-008, Auditing Standard No. 2201
verified_sources.notes: New amendments to AS 2201 become effective mid-December 2026; requires compliance planning now

_metadata.compliance_framework: Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 (SOX), Section 404 (Internal Control over Financial Reporting)
_metadata.note_on_materiality: NO quantitative threshold exists for material weakness. Definition is 'reasonable possibility of material misstatement' per PCAOB AS 2201. Auditor judgment required; thresholds vary by context.
